concepts_actual_uses_and_mixup: Item ID, display name, tags, kind and icon are separate identities/presentation roles. Physical masskg, exterior volumeml, contained capacityml, unit value, metric dimensions/grip/anchor, inertia kg-m2 and combat reach are distinct quantities. Food kcal, growth per hour, cooking minutes, flavor loads, culinary fat, quality and value do not establish their internal checked runtime representations. Alcohol serving/hydration ml and basis-point ABV are independent from native effectiveness/flags.

Equipment records distinguish anatomical surface region and fractional coverage, coarse protection label, occupied location/channel/fit zone, layers_over relation, parent requirement, attachment identity/tag/capacity/order, named skin UV domain/coordinates and tangent direction. Final belt four mounts carry body-surface UVs plus directions; sheath/scabbard/loop/satchel/holster and boot attachment graphs have distinct placement and containment semantics. Actual producer/receiver admission, UV/frame/count bounds, item-ID/geometry association and graph consistency require their own source obligations.

Final rigid/flexible armor records cover cuisse/rerebrace/poleyn/couter/pauldron/spaulder/gauntlet/sabaton/gorget and mail voiders/brayette/knee/standard. Empty occupancy on parent-attached voiders differs from absent protection or physical geometry. Named wound/surgery/quest/countermeasure tokens and books with written-language/religion/bestiary/skill/terrain targets remain authored native wire data. No database transaction, hidden combat penalty, renderer/rig correctness or whole-catalog runtime acceptance is inferred from data declarations.

This file is an actual authored catalog boundary with semantic field names and explicit physical units; its primitive literals are not evidence that Rust domain logic may carry unchecked values. Source correct classifications and complete parser/caller propagation remain separate. No new accepted type-granularity finding is established by this file alone.
